get_domain.label: Get Domain
get_domain.description: Get the settings of one Short.io domain.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Short.io domain hostname (e.g. link.example.com) or its numeric domain ID. Use List Domains to see them.

find_links_by_original_url.label: Find Links by Original URL
find_links_by_original_url.description: Find every short link on a domain that points to a given long URL.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Short.io domain hostname (e.g. link.example.com) or its numeric domain ID. Use List Domains to see them.

originalURL.label: Original URL
originalURL.description: The full destination URL to look up, exactly as it was shortened.

list_folders.label: List Folders
list_folders.description: List the link folders on a domain.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Short.io domain hostname (e.g. link.example.com) or its numeric domain ID. Use List Domains to see them.

create_folder.label: Create Folder
create_folder.description: Create a link folder on a domain.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Short.io domain hostname (e.g. link.example.com) or its numeric domain ID. Use List Domains to see them.

duplicate_link.label: Duplicate Short Link
duplicate_link.description: Create a copy of a short link with the same destination and settings.

linkId.label: Link ID
linkId.description: Short.io link ID: the idString field of a link, e.g. link_8yXK_034ebx7JWAtAAK3vFcl6ye.

path.label: New Path (Slug)
path.description: Slug for the copy, e.g. spring-sale-email. Empty = Short.io generates one.

get_folder.label: Get Folder
get_folder.description: Get a link folder by its ID.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Short.io domain hostname (e.g. link.example.com) or its numeric domain ID. Use List Domains to see them.

folderId.label: Folder ID
folderId.description: The folder ID, e.g. the FolderId field of a link.

get_link_open_graph.label: Get Link Social Preview (OpenGraph)
get_link_open_graph.description: Get the custom social-preview (OpenGraph) title, description and image set on a short link.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Short.io domain hostname (e.g. link.example.com) or its numeric domain ID. Use List Domains to see them.

linkId.label: Link ID
linkId.description: Short.io link ID: the idString field of a link, e.g. link_8yXK_034ebx7JWAtAAK3vFcl6ye.

find_link_by_path.label: Find Link by Short URL (AI)
find_link_by_path.description: Find a short link from its full short URL, or from a domain plus slug.

shortUrl.label: Short URL or Slug
shortUrl.description: Full short URL like https://link.example.com/promo, or just the slug "promo" when Domain is given.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Domain hostname or ID; needed only when Short URL is a bare slug.

get_domain_statistics.label: Get Domain Statistics (AI)
get_domain_statistics.description: Get click and link totals for a whole domain over a period.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Short.io domain hostname (e.g. link.example.com) or its numeric domain ID. Use List Domains to see them.

period.label: Period
period.description: Time period for the statistics. Default: last 30 days.

tz.label: Timezone
tz.description: IANA timezone for day boundaries, e.g. UTC or America/New_York. Defaults to UTC.
